title: PipelineConfig
description: Live pipeline configuration tuned and released by the Managed Agent behind gate_release.py.

config_id.description: Unique identifier for this configuration version (e.g. 'cfg-001').

window_s.description: Rolling audio-visual window length in seconds (default 3.0).

hop_s.description: Hop interval in seconds (default 0.5; 1.0 under FB2).

decision_threshold.description: Probability threshold for Decision 1 speaking detection (default 0.9).

guard_ms.description: Leakage guard hang-over/padding window in milliseconds around speaking intervals.

vocab.description: Custom vocabulary and consenting speaker names passed to Neon (from vocab.json).

translate_to.description: Optional BCP-47 language code or language name for Neon live translation, or null if off.

parent_config_id.description: Optional parent config_id this config was derived from.

notes.description: Optional summary of why this config was proposed.
